submissions.title: ESCRS London 2026: Next-Generation Cataract & Refractive Masterclass
submissions.summary: A clinical synthesis of key breakthroughs, advanced surgical techniques, and evidence-based protocols from the ESCRS London 2026 Congress. This guide distills next-generation IOL calculations, complex anterior segment reconstruction, refractive surgery advances, and complication prevention workflows into a high-yield study aid.
